(define (make-counter)
  (let ((n 0))
    (lambda () (set! n (+ n 1)) n)))
(define c1 (make-counter))
(define c2 (make-counter))
(c1) (c1)
(display (c1)) (display " ") (display (c2)) (newline)
(define (adder n) (lambda (x) (+ x n)))
(define add5 (adder 5))
(display (add5 10)) (newline)
(define (compose f g) (lambda (x) (f (g x))))
(display ((compose add5 (adder 1)) 0)) (newline)
(define (make-acc total)
  (lambda (amt) (set! total (+ total amt)) total))
(define acc (make-acc 100))
(acc 10)
(display (acc 10)) (newline)
